caption:
Stop blaming your hair products for the morning frizz.

Most pillowcases are cotton, and cotton pulls moisture out of hair and skin overnight while gripping onto both as you move. That friction is what turns smooth hair into tangles and presses a crease into your cheek by morning.

This is a set of two satin pillowcases in queen size, similar to silk, made for hair and skin. It has 323,000 reviews at 4.5 stars.
